resources.string: Emulator only · demo-splitease-auth · 127.0.0.1:9099. Use test credentials only. No production account or email is created. Profiles and unique usernames use the local Firestore Emulator on port 8080. Usernames: 3–30 letters, numbers or underscores. Cloud groups use the isolated emulator repository. Local data is never mixed in.
If an account exists, a reset request has been accepted. Emulator reset links are available only from its local test interface; no real email is sent.
